rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=1, unet_c=64, itnet_alpha_init=0.01, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.00025, pretrain_epochs=15, pretrain_patience=15, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=1200, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=ITER-11 (breast itnet_v2, extend-to-20, 20-min budget). SIX-BOX (VERIFIED): i8 c64/n1200/lr2.5e-4 0.8650; i9 c64/n2400 0.8686=BEST; i10 c64/n1200/lr5e-4 0.8651 (= i8 -> pretrain_lr is a DEAD knob, denoiser converges regardless). (2) FINDING: width, data, AND lr are all saturated/dead; the pretrain-denoiser+single-DC family plateaus ~0.865-0.869. The single k=1 DC step is near-VESTIGIAL: learned alpha settled tiny (~0.0014-0.0018) from alpha_init=0.0026, so data-consistency barely contributes. (3) ONE KNOB vs iter-8 (c64/n1200/lr2.5e-4 baseline): itnet_alpha_init 0.0026 -> 0.01 (~4x larger initial DC step, still learnable via softplus(log_alpha)). Revert lr to 2.5e-4. Hold c=64, n=1200, k=1, all else = champion. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if alpha_init 0.0026->0.01, hr rises above 0.8650 because a stronger initial DC step lets the single data-consistency correction actually enforce sinogram agreement on the denoised recon (currently the DC step is too weak to matter), and the learnable alpha can still shrink if 0.01 is too large. FALSIFIER: hr <= ~0.865 (flat) or worse (the k=2/k=4 collapse showed DC can CORRUPT on sparse breast) => a single DC step is intrinsically near-vestigial here regardless of alpha; iter-12 pivots to a real ARCHITECTURE change (denoiser depth / residual block) since scalar knobs are exhausted. (5) BUDGET: identical to iter-8 (c64/n1200) -- only alpha_init changes, no cost delta. (6) Serial gated loop; dispatch iter-12 only after iter-11 writes numeric-hr observation.json.
